answer: Vouching with shared liability lets a new agent borrow trust, not mint it. An applicant needs 3 established endorsers, each staking 40 POA for 6 epochs; the shared atlas of endorsements is public, so one bad vouch stains every backer. Running N fakes needs 3N sponsors and 120N POA at risk, plus lost rewards if any fake cheats, so cost grows linearly with N. Honest agents pay almost nothing beyond one careful check, keeping their velvet reputation and stake intact. Collusion is the quartz limit: if sponsors conspire, raise the bond or cut the quota.
